defects.summary: Execute endpoint references deleted legacy DAGScheduler and detect_cycle
defects.impact: POST /api/v1/conversations/{conversation_id}/plans/{plan_id}/execute crashes or fails at runtime

defects.summary: ExecutionRuntimePort interface missing and dispatcher does not invoke execution runtime
defects.impact: Dispatcher step_durable step returns True without actually executing tools/tasks

defects.summary: Workflow query API returns empty stub (steps=[])
defects.impact: GET /sessions/{session_id}/workflow does not return real durable workflow steps

defects.summary: Pause, resume, stop endpoints are in-memory transitions only
defects.impact: Operations do not pause/resume/cancel underlying execution runtime or propagate to durable process/step state

defects.summary: Retry step endpoint is a no-op
defects.impact: POST /workflow/{step_id}/retry returns fake success without executing new attempt

defects.summary: Startup recovery is not wired in FastAPI lifespan
defects.impact: In-flight runs are left orphaned across backend restarts
Benchmark metrics are fake and recovery 1000-run does not actually seed/reconcile 1000 records

defects.summary: Task run and lease state updates use non-atomic SELECT -> update pattern
Workflow state durability relies on RAM _active_runs
defects.impact: Workflow cannot reconstruct active state from SQLite checkpoint after restart

defects.summary: Outbox and event publishing is not transactional with state updates
defects.impact: Potential event loss or premature event broadcast prior to DB commit
